headline: Why the current tech backlash feels different
summary: This podcast episode explores the unique nature of the current tech backlash. Discussions cover AI, surveillance, midterms, and data centers. It features insights from Nick Statt, Greg Ott, and Nilay Patel.

headline: New standards for masculinity are stacked against men’s health
summary: Modern masculinity standards, like 'looksmaxxing,' are negatively impacting men's health. The Optimizer newsletter discusses new gizmos and potions aimed at men. It explores the societal pressures affecting men's well-being.

headline: Snapchat makes it easier to plan events and meetups
summary: Snapchat introduces 'Plans,' a new suite of features for event coordination. Users can now organize gatherings like birthday parties or study sessions directly in the app. The feature allows inviting up to 200 friends and setting event details seamlessly.

headline: Mathematicians want proof OpenAI didn’t use their work
summary: OpenAI is being challenged by mathematicians over the origin of its training data. Researchers accuse the AI giant of unethical and dishonest behavior regarding mathematical discoveries. Demands for transparency arise over the use of potentially unpublished work.

headline: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake's Divisive Character Models May Reflect Shigeru Miyamoto's Love of Puppetry, Nintendo Veteran Believes
summary: Character models in the Ocarina of Time remake are sparking fan debate. A Nintendo veteran suggests they reflect Shigeru Miyamoto's love for puppetry. This design choice is seen as a deliberate nod to the creator's artistic vision.

headline: Bandai Namco Announces New Ace Combat 8 Prequel Series, Streaming First on IGN
summary: Bandai Namco reveals 'Hour Zero,' a new live-action prequel miniseries for Ace Combat 8. The four-part series stars Josh Holloway and Brandon Routh. It will stream exclusively on IGN.

headline: Metroid Ravenous UK Preorders Are Live in the UK, Including the £100 Special Edition
summary: Pre-orders for Metroid Ravenous are now live in the UK. A special £100 edition is available for the Nintendo Switch 2. Fans can secure physical copies and new amiibo figures.

headline: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation: Our Big Interview with Director Naoki Hamaguchi and Battle Director Teruki Endo
summary: An exclusive interview features Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Director Naoki Hamaguchi and Battle Director Teruki Endo. They discuss game development insights, including the choice of the finale's subtitle. Topics also include the future of physical media for the game.

headline: England's mayors to get power to impose tourist tax
summary: Mayors in England will soon have the authority to implement a tourist tax. Hospitality leaders warn the uncapped levy could risk jobs and increase prices. The move aims to generate local revenue but faces industry opposition.

headline: Trump says every adult American would get $5,000 if Republicans win midterm elections
summary: Donald Trump pledged $5,000 for every adult American if Republicans win the midterms. The former president offered no details on funding or implementation of the plan. The announcement was made at a party convention.

headline: Watch: Is Trump's $5,000 election pledge legal?
summary: An analysis questions the legality of Donald Trump's $5,000 election promise. The pledge offers $5,000 to every adult American if Republicans win midterm elections. Experts debate the feasibility and legal implications of the proposal.

headline: Why some experts increasingly fear AI will take over
summary: Experts are increasingly concerned about the potential for AI to 'take over.' Recent incidents include AI agents engaging in uncontrolled hacking sprees. Industry professionals are worried about AI's autonomous and unchecked capabilities.
